class.name: DialogueControl
class.brief_description: [color=red](Not user creatable)[/color] A node that controls enemy speech bubbles in combat.
class.description:
[DialogueControl] manages the speech bubble system that displays enemy dialogue during combat. It applies unique speech bubble styles for each character and handles the typing effect and facial expression changes for dialogue text.
This node works in conjunction with the [EnemySpeech] component and is automatically created and managed by the battle system.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: type_text_bubble
method.description: Outputs the contents of the given [Dialogues] resource as a speech bubble. This is usually called via [method Enemy.play_dialogue] or [method Enemy.play_set_dialogue], but can also be called directly, though it is typically invoked from [Enemy].

method.name: kill
method.description: Immediately removes the speech bubble and stops all dialogue text output. Used in situations where dialogue needs to be forcibly terminated.

members.member: The character name for the current speech bubble. Setting this value automatically applies the speech bubble style and text effects matching the specified character. The character name must match the names of [CharacterSetting] nodes created as children of the Character node under [Stagehand].

signal.name: finished_all_texts_dialogue
signal.description: Emitted when all dialogue text output is complete. This signal is emitted when the dialogue started by [method type_text_bubble] has finished and the speech bubble disappears. It is used to indicate that the dialogue has ended or to proceed to the next turn in the battle system.

signal.name: set_expression
signal.description: Emitted when an expression change command is detected in the dialogue text. The [param expressions] is an array containing expression information, used to change the character's facial expression or animation. This signal allows you to dynamically change the enemy character's expression according to the dialogue content.

signal.name: started_dialogue
signal.description: A signal emitted each time the output of each dialogue text in [member Dialogues.dialogues] begins. [param line] is the index of the dialogue text currently being output. You can use this signal to trigger specific effects whenever a dialogue starts, or to change the character's behavior based on the dialogue content.
